I actually helped my previous company migrate from Magento to BigCommerce, and found their offering incredibly compelling compared to Shopify. My favorite feature of BigCommerce was the ability to run the site locally for development, using live product data from the site.

The main issue with BigCommerce is that they do not offer any compelling advantage over existing open source system... for unique shopping experience they fall short and better to build customized one with complete control.

Met Brent at the BigCommerce partner summit... I can't think of a CEO I've met who is more open and accessible... his exec leadership team all were equally inviting and open to feedback about the product and strategy.

I did try BigCommerce, but there were many issue with them. The software was very slow, and the app ecosystem was rather incomplete. From what I understand... they weren't able to dependibly connect to the API without throttling or losing connection.
It looks like BigCommerce offers single sign on for customer accounts, which Shopify charges an outrageous $2K/month to turn on with their Plus plan.

I've never had a worse webdev experience than attempting to create a BigCommerce theme. There are hundreds of theme files, and a maddeningly incomplete and inconsistent templating tag system... I now hate BigCommerce for being so hard to work with.
